zh.title: 美軍首批常駐海外F-15EX戰機抵日本嘉手納　開啟駐日機隊換裝
zh.summary: 美國空軍首批常駐海外的F-15EX Eagle II戰機11月15日抵達沖繩嘉手納空軍基地，由第67戰鬥機中隊接收，推進老舊F-15C／D汰換。
body: 美國空軍第18聯隊證實，首批永久配置海外基地的F-15EX Eagle II戰鬥機已於11月15日抵達日本沖繩嘉手納空軍基地（DNA），由第67戰鬥機中隊接收。這是美國空軍首度在海外基地部署具作戰編制的F-15EX，也使嘉手納成為繼奧勒岡州波特蘭空軍國民兵基地之後，第二處接收此型戰機的美國空軍駐地。
嘉手納基地過去長期操作F-15C／D戰鬥機，但這批舊型機自2022年11月開始分階段撤離；在新機接裝期間，美軍透過不同批次的第四、第五代戰機輪調維持戰備。第67戰鬥機中隊人員此前赴佛羅里達州艾格林空軍基地，以及奧勒岡州波特蘭空軍國民兵基地完成相關訓練，為新機投入使用做準備。
F-15EX配備更新的航電、電子戰系統，並擴大武器掛載能力。美國空軍指出，這次進駐將加強在西太平洋的防空與應變能力，後續仍需配合人員訓練與維保整備逐步形成完整戰力。官方發布的照片顯示，首架F-15EX於嘉手納降落後滑行，留下新型戰機正式接裝的紀錄。

en.title: First permanently based US Air Force F-15EX fighters arrive at Kadena in Japan
en.summary: The first permanently assigned F-15EX Eagle II fighters reached Kadena Air Base on November 15, beginning the replacement of its legacy F-15C/D fleet.
body: The US Air Force's 18th Wing announced that the first permanently assigned F-15EX Eagle II fighters arrived at Kadena Air Base, Japan, on November 15, 2026. The 67th Fighter Squadron received the aircraft, making Kadena the first overseas Air Force installation to host combat-coded F-15EX fighters and the second USAF location to field the type after Portland, Oregon.

Kadena began a phased withdrawal of its long-serving F-15C/D aircraft in November 2022. Rotational deployments of fourth- and fifth-generation fighters helped preserve a continuous fighter presence during the transition. Members of the 67th Fighter Squadron trained at Eglin Air Force Base and Portland Air National Guard Base in preparation for operating the new aircraft.

The F-15EX introduces updated avionics, electronic warfare equipment and greater weapons capacity. The Air Force says the deployment strengthens its ability to respond across the Pacific alongside Japanese partners. Further aircraft arrivals and the progression of training and maintenance will remain part of the transition to sustained operations.

zh.title: 中東航空接收首架空中巴士A321XLR客機
zh.summary: 中東航空接收首架空中巴士A321XLR，客機採雙艙等共160席。
body: 黎巴嫩的中東航空（Middle East Airlines，MEA）接收訂購的五架空中巴士A321XLR客機中的首架。交機於2026年11月17日在漢堡附近Finkenwerder（XFW）的製造商設施舉行。
據AeroTime報導，這架客機的註冊編號為OD-XLR。客機將從交機地點出發，執行飛往貝魯特拉菲克・哈里里國際機場（BEY）的交付航班。
空中巴士表示，中東航空的A321XLR採雙艙等配置，共有160個座位，其中22席為可全平躺的商務艙座椅，另有138席經濟艙。中東航空曾於2019年巴黎航空展率先為此機型下達確定訂單。

en.title: Middle East Airlines receives its first Airbus A321XLR aircraft
en.summary: Middle East Airlines receives its first Airbus A321XLR, with 160 seats in two classes.
body: Middle East Airlines (MEA), Lebanon’s national carrier, has taken delivery of the first of five Airbus A321XLR aircraft it has on order. The handover took place on November 17, 2026 at the manufacturer’s facility in Finkenwerder (XFW), near Hamburg.
According to AeroTime, the newly delivered aircraft is registered OD-XLR. It is due to depart from the handover site on a delivery flight to Beirut’s Rafic-Hariri International Airport (BEY).

Airbus said MEA’s A321XLR has 160 seats in two classes, including 22 fully lie-flat business-class seats and 138 economy seats. MEA was the first airline to place a firm order for the type at the Paris Air Show in 2019.

zh.title: Azul Conecta首架SkyCourier投入亞馬遜營運　與巴西石油公司簽四年運輸合約
zh.summary: Azul Conecta首架19座Cessna SkyCourier（PS-ENE）已於11月3日投入服務，協助Petrobras接駁亞馬遜地區員工，部分航段同步對一般旅客售票。
body: 巴西藍色航空旗下區域業者Azul Conecta首架Cessna 408 SkyCourier已於11月3日投入營運，機身註冊編號為PS-ENE。根據AeroTime與CNN Brasil報導，該機主要執行與巴西國營石油公司Petrobras簽訂的四年員工運輸合約，服務巴西亞馬遜州的石油及天然氣作業區。
SkyCourier配置19個旅客座位，較Azul Conecta既有Cessna Grand Caravan的9座運能增加逾一倍。航空公司希望利用這款雙發渦輪螺旋槳飛機，銜接小型Caravan與載客量較大的ATR 72之間的區域運輸需求。依公司向巴西媒體說明的規劃，週五班機將由Carauari經Coari飛往Manaus，週一反向飛行，並在運送石油業員工之餘向一般旅客開放部分座位。
Azul Conecta表示，預期於2027年上半年接收第二架SkyCourier，並持續評估擴增機隊與新航線的可能性。這項部署反映亞馬遜地區城市間陸路交通受地理條件限制，小型區域航空在員工接駁與公共交通兩方面仍扮演重要角色。

en.title: Azul Conecta deploys first Cessna SkyCourier on Petrobras services in Brazil
en.summary: Azul Conecta's first 19-seat Cessna SkyCourier, PS-ENE, entered service in November under a four-year Petrobras transport contract in the Brazilian Amazon.
body: Azul Conecta has introduced its first Cessna 408 SkyCourier, registered PS-ENE, into service in Brazil. The 19-seat twin-turboprop began operations on November 3, 2026, supporting a four-year contract to transport Petrobras personnel in the Amazonas region, according to AeroTime and CNN Brasil.

The SkyCourier offers more than twice the nine-seat capacity of Azul Conecta's Cessna Grand Caravans, allowing the regional subsidiary to serve routes that are growing beyond Caravan demand but remain too thin for an ATR 72. Its planned Friday service from Carauari via Coari to Manaus, with a reverse routing on Mondays, will also offer tickets to members of the public.

The airline expects to receive a second SkyCourier in the first half of 2027 and is considering additional regional applications. The project highlights the role of small aircraft in connecting remote Amazon communities and supporting industrial transport where ground infrastructure is limited.
